title: Validate bounded public chat and reactions with spectator denial
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/SWARM_BENCHMARK.md, docs/PILOT100_READY.md, docs/PILOT100_DOMAIN_CONTRACTS.md and the task sourceRefs before editing. This is an independent leaf in the B001–B100 cohort, not an integration or completed feature claim. Implement only the owned source and tests, using the exact pinned API section in PILOT100_DOMAIN_CONTRACTS. No imports from unmerged A/B modules, no manifests/barrels/App.tsx/shared task metadata edits and no new dependencies. Locally declare the contract's shared structural types; package engine/protocol production stays ES2022-only and pure, with no Firebase, browser, Node, UI, credentials, wall clock or global randomness. Use existing deterministic engine RNG only where the contract permits. Never turn a trusted verifier input into a claim of cryptographic verification. Unspecified rules remain explicit named decision-required results; no worker invents policies. Preserve existing T01–T10 API/tests. Run scoped lint/typecheck/tests, then node tools/benchmark-pilot.mjs --profile full. Return a handoff with paths, API, actual checks, benchmark receipt references and limitations. No commits, pushes, PRs, child agents, deployment, credential access, task-issue mutation or budget changes. Implement decodePublicChatAction exactly as frozen in section B089 of docs/PILOT100_DOMAIN_CONTRACTS.md. Active verified members may submit only public text or allowlisted semantic reactions when capability is enabled. Text is trimmed1–280 Unicode scalars, rejects controls except newline, and is always treated as text, never HTML. Exact keys for chat(type,text) or reaction(type,reactionId); no supplied actor/role/recipient whisper/channel override. Rate limiting/storage remain adapter work.
acceptance: Active chat and allowlisted reactions decode with bounded detached data; HTML-looking content remains inert text data.
Permanent spectator and unavailable capability deny both actions without revealing any private role.
Empty/overlong/control text, unknown reactions, forged identities, accessors and unknown keys reject without getters or payload echo.
The exported implementation matches the frozen local structural API, preserves legacy APIs, and changes only declared ownership; no unresolved rule is silently decided.

Scoped lint, typecheck and meaningful tests pass, followed by node tools/benchmark-pilot.mjs --profile full; handoff records actual outcomes and receipt references without claiming App/provider integration.
